svg.title: NavUS mobile navigation prototype
svg.desc: Five static screen concepts for Explore, venue detail, shuttle route browsing, Stops and Plan. Screens follow a 390 by 844 proportion; the map is schematic.
svg.text: Low-fidelity flow prototype · map-first light theme · existing capabilities only

D2 order shown from public/data/shuttle-network.json: COM 3 → Opp TCOMS → PGP → Kent Ridge MRT → LT 27 → University Hall → Opp UHC → Museum → UTown → UHC → Opp UHall → S 17 → Opp KR MRT → PGP Foyer → TCOMS → COM 3.
Plan uses canonical A1 stops Kent Ridge Bus Terminal → Prince George’s Park. Duration is runtime-generated and labeled an estimate; no crowding or vehicle progress is shown.
